prompt_protocol.point_rule: First row-major GT pixel at maximum Euclidean distance to background
prompt_protocol.box_rule: Inclusive tight box of the GT mask
prompt_protocol.shift_rule: dx=round(sx*a*bbox_width), dy=round(sy*a*bbox_height), then coordinate-wise image clipping

setups.setup1: MobileSAM versus SAM ViT-B on clean point and clean box prompts
setups.setup2: Clean point versus clean box on SAM ViT-B; reuses Setup 1 SAM rows
setups.setup3: SAM ViT-B robustness at noise levels 0.1 and 0.2 with three trials

inference.seconds_scope: predict call for one prompt only
inference.encode_seconds_scope: set_image call once per model and image
